mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy environment that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above the 50th percentile of its historical range.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-3.5% unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an overheated labor market that typically triggers inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a strong economy with inflationary risks, prompting central bank tightening that results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between UNRATE and RSAFS shows a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern fails when both series are in the extreme states.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that forces central banks to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that typically leads to central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates excessive demand growth that may trigger inflation and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS shows a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern fails when both series are in the top 25% of historical values.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 255.5 (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that typically leads to immediate market concerns about rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.5.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, high housing starts (HOUST) signal excessive demand that often precedes monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.
